Verified external archive canonical parent/device, no-follow descriptor identity, full SHA readback at16MiB/s, repeated mount-ID/device/inode stability checks; restore receipt file, proof-directory and its parent fsynced before source removal.

Verified retained fixed exclusions, exact source/quarantine paths, reused private helpers retargeted to all nine names plus quarantines, repeated live consumers/config/mount/alias checks, exclusive outputs and no automatic retry/adoption.

Independently executed three real tiny-filesystem failure tests at nice19 CPU0,1 with CUDA hidden: new proof-directory parent fsync failure preserves full quarantine; post-quarantine consumer rejection preserves full quarantine; partial rmtree failure preserves archive/restore pointer/proof and records partial-stage failure without completion receipts. 3 passed in0.43s.

launch_conditions: Use exact frozen reviewed script and plan. Parent owns detached launch with nice19, ionice3, CPU0,1 and proposed1GiB address-space cap.
Actual host process/dependency checks, source metadata qualification, external full SHA and durability operations remain mandatory runtime gates; this review does not substitute for them.
Do not edit running archive driver, training checkout or pinned inputs. Do not retry failed or interrupted state automatically.
limits: No production source scan, large manifest scan, archive payload readback, inference, copy, rename or deletion was performed by reviewer.
Tiny fixtures substitute host mounts and process observations; parent supplied pinned fresh actual-host dependency evidence and external directory fsync probe.

Relies on previous per-member content verification plus unchanged historical source metadata; does not detect silent source corruption with unchanged metadata or assert independent ACL/xattr equality.
Known inaccessible process identities, arbitrary external aliases and future consumers remain explicitly qualified; new inaccessible live identities or observed references stop execution.
Pre-removal failures retain original/full quarantine; removal interruption may leave partial quarantine with verified external restore evidence. Logical bytes are not measured reclaimed allocation.
